text:
alex: Quickstart hang on first generate after accepting invite. curl shows 402 Payment Required on /v1/chat/completions. anyone run into this? :thinking:

rhea: which workspace and which sample?

alex: org: org-merlin-test, sample: ts-starter-app from the README. repro curl pasted below.

alex: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

# => HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
# {"error":"workspace_payment_required","message":"Attach payment method or enable trial","links":{"billing":"/console/orgs/org-merlin-test/billing"}}```

sam: odd that curl response includes a links field. we recently added console hint but maybe not all codepaths set it. Did this org come from SSO provisioning or email signup?

alex: invited via SSO link. console didn't show any trial CTA on accept.

nico: known gap: SSO-provisioned invites sometimes skip toggling trial=true for pooled orgs. Also saw a separate bug where the TypeScript SDK maps 402 to AuthenticationError instead of a BillingRequiredError, which surfaced in our starter app logs.

rhea: filing console ticket and pinging billing. billing, can you check org state?

billing-bot: Checked: org-merlin-test: payment_source=null, trial_flag=false, created_via=okta-sso. Will flip trial=true temporarily on request.

alex: please flip so I can run CI smoke.

billing-bot: trial=true applied for org-merlin-test. propagation expected ~25s. case #8120 created.

alex: re-run after 30s  generator returns 200, tokens consumed, CI green. :tada:

alex: dev notes: 1) Starter README should call out billing gating and link to `redwood billing status --org` example 2) API should always include console billing link in 402 body when available 3) SDKs must map 402 -> BillingRequiredError (TS SDK currently mis-maps) 4) console: surface trial CTA during SSO invite accept or show explicit hint that billing may be required

rhea: i'll add SDK task for error mapping and a quick PR to the ts-starter README. also adding CLI helper RFC `redwood orgs enable-trial <org>` for admins.

nico: also suggest instrumenting invite flow to log whether trial toggle was applied, so we can alert on failures.

alex: thanks all. tagging @platform-sre in case routing/auth triggers need a look.

onboard-bot: case #8120 opened: "SSO invite not setting trial flag for pooled orgs"	6 assigned: rhea, console-team, priority: P2.
